FVector accepts [X,Y,Z] or one broadcast number; FRotator requires [Pitch,Yaw,Roll]; FLinearColor requires [R,G,B,A]; these values have magnitude at most 1e12. Enums accept a declared name or value. Add one local SCS component with validated initial properties and observed hierarchy. Initial support is a runtime-safe /Game Actor Blueprint and four exact Engine classes; inherited/native templates, arbitrary plugin classes and external property propagation remain unsupported. Never saves. Unlike legacy's ignored component_properties, unsupported values fail explicitly.

        Args:
            blueprint_name: Exact /Game Blueprint package/object path or simple name under /Game/Blueprints. Selectors are at most 1023 UTF-16 units without controls; native name/template-slot guards can be stricter.
            component_type: Runtime Engine SceneComponent, StaticMeshComponent, CameraComponent or SpringArmComponent. Their U-prefix, /Script/Engine class path and short base-name aliases resolve to the same exact native class.
            component_name: Requested exact new local component variable name: ASCII identifier with 1..100 characters, not None. Existing/conflicting names fail without silently generating a different identity.
            location_json: JSON string [X,Y,Z], default [0,0,0]. Exactly three finite numbers, not booleans; magnitude at most 1e12.
            rotation_json: JSON string [Pitch,Yaw,Roll], default [0,0,0], with the same numeric bounds.
            scale_json: JSON string [X,Y,Z], default [1,1,1], with the same numeric bounds.
            parent_component: Optional exact existing local scene parent. Omitted/null/empty uses the sole local scene root, typically DefaultSceneRoot. Multiple roots require an explicit parent; an empty valid SCS may create its first root.
            component_properties_json: Explicit JSON-object adapter for legacy heterogeneous properties, default {}. At most 64 fields. Native typed scalar/vector/rotator/color/enum/name/string/text subset only; arbitrary aggregates/object/class references unsupported except checked StaticMeshComponent.StaticMesh. Use the transform arguments for RelativeLocation/RelativeRotation/RelativeScale3D; conflicting property fields fail. JSON text at most 65536 UTF-16 units, depth 8 and 1024 values; duplicate keys, nonfinite/numeric magnitude beyond 2^53-1, NUL and unpaired surrogates fail before dispatch. Property names at most 1023 UTF-16 units.
            compile_blueprint: True preserves legacy's full compile boundary with diagnostics and SkipSave. False explicitly defers full compile for authoring batches; implicit structural engine work is separately reported. Finish the batch with one named compile action.
            operation_id: Optional durable ID; omitted/null generates a returned ID. Same ID and normalized arguments replay its recorded result. Interrupted or uncertain operations never automatically retry.
